COMMAND.help-id: Simbol fungsi (birdc show symbols function)

COMMAND.name: show symbols protocol
COMMAND.help: Protocol symbols (birdc show symbols protocol)
COMMAND.help-id: Simbol protokol (birdc show symbols protocol)

COMMAND.name: show symbols template

COMMAND.help-id: Simbol template (birdc show symbols template)

COMMAND.help-id: Satu simbol (birdc show symbols symbol)

COMMAND.help-id: Interface yang dilihat BIRD (birdc show interfaces) — bedakan dari `show interfaces` OS

COMMAND.name: show interfaces bird summary
COMMAND.help: Interfaces seen by BIRD, summary (birdc show interfaces summary)
COMMAND.help-id: Interface yang dilihat BIRD, ringkas (birdc show interfaces summary)

COMMAND.name: show route
COMMAND.help: BIRD routing table contents (birdc show route)
COMMAND.help-id: Isi tabel routing BIRD (birdc show route)

COMMAND.name: show route help
COMMAND.help: Subcommand show route list (paged)
COMMAND.help-id: Daftar sub-perintah show route (dipager)

COMMAND.help: Routes + all attributes (birdc show route all)
COMMAND.help-id: Route + semua atribut (birdc show route all)

COMMAND.name: show route count
COMMAND.help: Only statistics route (birdc show route count)
COMMAND.help-id: Hanya statistik route (birdc show route count)

COMMAND.name: show route stats
COMMAND.help: Route statistics (birdc show route stats)
COMMAND.help-id: Statistik route (birdc show route stats)

COMMAND.name: show route for
COMMAND.help: Routes used for forwarding to this destination (birdc show route for <prefix>)
COMMAND.help-id: Route yang dipakai forwarding ke destinasi ini (birdc show route for <prefix>)

COMMAND.name: show route in
COMMAND.help: All this prefixes that covered prefix (birdc show route in <prefix>)
COMMAND.help-id: Semua prefix yang tercakup prefix ini (birdc show route in <prefix>)

COMMAND.name: show route table
COMMAND.help: Route from one table (birdc show route table <name|all>)
COMMAND.help-id: Route dari satu tabel (birdc show route table <nama|all>)

COMMAND.name: show route table all
COMMAND.help: Route from all tables (birdc show route table all)
COMMAND.help-id: Route dari semua tabel (birdc show route table all)

COMMAND.name: show route protocol
COMMAND.help: Only route from one protocol (birdc show route protocol <name>)
COMMAND.help-id: Hanya route dari satu protokol (birdc show route protocol <nama>)

COMMAND.name: show route export
COMMAND.help: Route exported to this protocol (birdc show route export <name>)
COMMAND.help-id: Route yang di-export ke protokol ini (birdc show route export <nama>)

COMMAND.name: show route preexport
COMMAND.help: Exported routes without an export filter (birdc show route preexport <name>)
COMMAND.help-id: Route export tanpa export filter (birdc show route preexport <nama>)

COMMAND.name: show route noexport
COMMAND.help: Routes rejected by the export filter (birdc show route noexport <name>)
COMMAND.help-id: Route yang ditolak export filter (birdc show route noexport <nama>)

COMMAND.name: show route where
COMMAND.help: Routes matching a filter condition, use quotes: show route where "net ~ [ 10.0.0.0/8+ ]" (birdc show route where <condition>)
COMMAND.help-id: Route cocok kondisi filter, pakai kutip: show route where "net ~ [ 10.0.0.0/8+ ]" (birdc show route where <kondisi>)

COMMAND.name: show route filter
COMMAND.help: Test an inline filter against the route table (birdc show route filter { if ... then accept; }); named forms are NOT supported by BIRD 2.20 — inline only
COMMAND.help-id: Uji filter inline terhadap tabel route (birdc show route filter { if ... then accept; }); bentuk bernama TIDAK didukung BIRD 2.20 — hanya inline

PARAM.name: cond
PARAM.help: COND condition (one token) (e.g. net~10.0.0.0/8 or roa:R4,net,bgp_path.last=ROA_VALID)
PARAM.help-id: Kondisi COND satu token (mis. net~10.0.0.0/8 atau roa:R4,net,bgp_path.last=ROA_VALID)

COMMAND.name: show route import
COMMAND.help: Import table channel (birdc show route import table <protocol.channel>)
COMMAND.help-id: Import table channel (birdc show route import table <protokol.channel>)

COMMAND.name: show route primary
COMMAND.help: Only primary (active) routes in the table (birdc show route primary)
COMMAND.help-id: Hanya route primary (aktif) di tabel (birdc show route primary)

COMMAND.name: show route primary count
COMMAND.help: Primary route statistics (birdc show route primary count)
COMMAND.help-id: Statistik route primary (birdc show route primary count)

COMMAND.name: show route filtered
COMMAND.help: Routes held by the filter (not primary) in the table (birdc show route filtered)
COMMAND.help-id: Route yang tertahan filter (tidak primary) di tabel (birdc show route filtered)

COMMAND.name: show route filtered count
COMMAND.help: Route statistics held back by the filter (birdc show route filtered count)
COMMAND.help-id: Statistik route tertahan filter (birdc show route filtered count)

COMMAND.name: show route import table
COMMAND.help: Contents of one channel's import table (birdc show route import table <protocol.channel>); a channel without an import table answers empty
COMMAND.help-id: Isi import table satu channel (birdc show route import table <protokol.channel>); channel tanpa import table menjawab kosong

COMMAND.name: show route export table
COMMAND.help: Contents of one channel's export table (birdc show route export table <protocol.channel>); a channel without an export table answers empty
COMMAND.help-id: Isi export table satu channel (birdc show route export table <protokol.channel>); channel tanpa export table menjawab kosong

PARAM.help-id: all atau nama instance; kosong = ringkas semua

COMMAND.name: show ospf topology all
COMMAND.help: Topology of all nodes in the OSPF LSDB (birdc show ospf topology all)
COMMAND.help-id: Topologi semua node di LSDB OSPF (birdc show ospf topology all)

COMMAND.help: OSPF LSA database contents (birdc show OSPF lsadb; filter area/type/lsid not yet exposed)
COMMAND.help-id: Isi OSPF LSA database (birdc show ospf lsadb; filter area/type/lsid belum diekspos)

COMMAND.name: show rip interfaces
COMMAND.help: Info detail interface RIP (birdc show RIP interfaces [name] [interface])
COMMAND.help-id: Info detail interface RIP (birdc show rip interfaces [nama] [interface])

COMMAND.help: RIP neighbors + state (birdc show rip neighbors [name] [interface])

COMMAND.name: configure reload
COMMAND.help: Reload BIRD.conf to daemon that running (birdc configure; equivalent to SIGHUP)
COMMAND.help-id: Muat ulang bird.conf ke daemon yang sedang jalan (birdc configure; setara SIGHUP)

COMMAND.name: configure check
COMMAND.help: Check validity BIRD.conf without apply (birdc configure check)
COMMAND.help-id: Cek validitas bird.conf tanpa apply (birdc configure check)

COMMAND.name: configure confirm
COMMAND.help: Confirm configuration running, disable timer undo (birdc configure confirm)
COMMAND.help-id: Konfirmasi konfigurasi berjalan, matikan timer undo (birdc configure confirm)

COMMAND.name: configure undo
COMMAND.help: Back to configuration previous, one level (birdc configure undo)
COMMAND.help-id: Kembali ke konfigurasi sebelumnya, satu level (birdc configure undo)

COMMAND.name: configure soft
COMMAND.help: Reload configuration without restart protocol (birdc configure soft)
COMMAND.help-id: Muat ulang konfigurasi tanpa restart protokol (birdc configure soft)

COMMAND.name: configure timeout
COMMAND.help: Reload configuration with timer undo (birdc configure timeout [seconds]; without a number = 300 sec; confirm: configure confirm)
COMMAND.help-id: Muat ulang konfigurasi dengan timer undo (birdc configure timeout [detik]; tanpa angka = 300 dtk; konfirmasi: configure confirm)

PARAM.help: Timeout in seconds; empty = BIRD default (300)

COMMAND.name: configure file
COMMAND.help: Load configuration from file another (birdc configure "<file>"; file must be present + can read)
COMMAND.help-id: Muat konfigurasi dari file lain (birdc configure "<file>"; file harus ada + bisa dibaca)

COMMAND.name: configure soft timeout
COMMAND.help: Reload without restart protocol + timer undo (birdc configure soft timeout [seconds])
COMMAND.help-id: Muat ulang tanpa restart protokol + timer undo (birdc configure soft timeout [detik])

PARAM.name: num
PARAM.help: Timeout in seconds; empty = BIRD default (300)

COMMAND.name: configure soft file
COMMAND.help: Load configuration from file another without restart protocol (birdc configure soft "<file>")
COMMAND.help-id: Muat konfigurasi dari file lain tanpa restart protokol (birdc configure soft "<file>")

COMMAND.name: configure file timeout
COMMAND.help: Load configuration from file another + timer undo (birdc configure "<file>" timeout [seconds])
COMMAND.help-id: Muat konfigurasi dari file lain + timer undo (birdc configure "<file>" timeout [detik])

PARAM.name: num
PARAM.help: Timeout in seconds; empty = BIRD default (300)

COMMAND.name: configure soft file timeout
COMMAND.help: Load configuration from file another without restart protocol + timer undo (birdc configure soft "<file>" timeout [seconds])
COMMAND.help-id: Muat konfigurasi dari file lain tanpa restart protokol + timer undo (birdc configure soft "<file>" timeout [detik])

PARAM.name: num
PARAM.help: Timeout in seconds; empty = BIRD default (300)

COMMAND.name: debug
COMMAND.help: Control debugging protocol: debug <protocol|pattern|all> all|off|states,routes,filters,interfaces,events,packets
COMMAND.help-id: Kontrol debugging protokol: debug <protokol|pola|all> all|off|states,routes,filters,interfaces,events,packets

PARAM.name: proto
PARAM.help: Name protocol, pattern (* allowed), or all
PARAM.help-id: Nama protokol, pola (* diizinkan), atau all

COMMAND.name: debug all
COMMAND.help: Enable all debugging all protocols (birdc debug all all)
COMMAND.help-id: Nyalakan semua debugging semua protokol (birdc debug all all)

COMMAND.name: debug off
COMMAND.help: Disable all debugging all protocols (birdc debug all off)
COMMAND.help-id: Matikan semua debugging semua protokol (birdc debug all off)

COMMAND.name: down
COMMAND.help: Stop the BIRD daemon — this command ONLY shows a confirmation; execution: down confirm
COMMAND.help-id: Matikan daemon BIRD — perintah ini HANYA menampilkan konfirmasi; eksekusi: down confirm

COMMAND.name: down confirm
COMMAND.help: EXECUTE: stop the BIRD daemon (birdc down)
COMMAND.help-id: EKSEKUSI: matikan daemon BIRD (birdc down)

COMMAND.name: graceful-restart
COMMAND.help: Stop the BIRD daemon for graceful restart — this command ONLY shows a confirmation; execution: graceful-restart confirm
COMMAND.help-id: Matikan daemon BIRD untuk graceful restart — perintah ini HANYA menampilkan konfirmasi; eksekusi: graceful-restart confirm

COMMAND.name: graceful-restart confirm
COMMAND.help: EXECUTE: stop the BIRD daemon for graceful restart (birdc graceful restart)
COMMAND.help-id: EKSEKUSI: matikan daemon BIRD untuk graceful restart (birdc graceful restart)

COMMAND.name: eval
COMMAND.help: Evaluate a BIRD filter expression, using quotes: eval "1+2" (birdc eval <expr>)
COMMAND.help-id: Evaluasi ekspresi filter BIRD, pakai kutip: eval "1+2" (birdc eval <expr>)

COMMAND.name: echo
COMMAND.help: Control echo log to output CLI: echo all|off|info,warning,error,fatal,debug,trace,remote,auth,bug
COMMAND.help-id: Kontrol echo log ke output CLI: echo all|off|info,warning,error,fatal,debug,trace,remote,auth,bug

PARAM.name: spec
PARAM.help: all | off | comma-separated log class list
PARAM.help-id: all | off | daftar kelas log koma

COMMAND.name: dump
COMMAND.help: Dump BIRD's internal data structures to a file (file must not exist yet; only readable by the daemon user)
COMMAND.help-id: Dump struktur data internal BIRD ke file (file belum boleh ada; hanya readable user daemon)

PARAM.name: file
PARAM.help: Path file absolute (must not exist yet)

COMMAND.name: mrt
COMMAND.help: MRT on-demand command (birdc mrt dump table)
COMMAND.help-id: Perintah MRT on-demand (birdc mrt dump table)

COMMAND.name: mrt dump
COMMAND.help: MRT dump on-demand
COMMAND.help-id: Dump MRT on-demand

COMMAND.name: mrt dump table
COMMAND.help: Dump contents routing table to file MRT (birdc MRT dump table <table> to <file>; filter/where not yet exposed)
COMMAND.help-id: Dump isi tabel routing ke file MRT (birdc mrt dump table <tabel> to <file>; filter/where belum diekspos)

PARAM.name: file
PARAM.help: Path file absolute (must not exist yet)

COMMAND.name: timeformat
COMMAND.help: Override the date/time format of this birdc session only (birdc timeformat <format> [limit <format2>]); the configuration format is in bird global
COMMAND.help-id: Override format tanggal/waktu sesi birdc ini saja (birdc timeformat <format> [limit <format2>]); format konfigurasi ada di bird global

PARAM.name: fmt
PARAM.help: Format: iso long|iso long ms|iso long us|iso short|iso short ms|iso short us, or strftime contains % (quote if contains space)
PARAM.help-id: Format: iso long|iso long ms|iso long us|iso short|iso short ms|iso short us, atau strftime mengandung % (kutip bila mengandung spasi)

COMMAND.name: birdc
COMMAND.help: Raw birdc command (quote it entirely, e.g. birdc "show status"); down/graceful restart are blocked — use the confirmation gateway
COMMAND.help-id: Perintah birdc mentah (kutip seluruhnya, mis. birdc "show status"); down/graceful restart diblok — pakai gerbang konfirmasi

COMMAND.name: birdc socket
COMMAND.help: Show/set the birdc control socket used by klish (default: bird.ctl); set requires the socket to already exist + answer birdc
COMMAND.help-id: Tampilkan/set socket kontrol birdc yang dipakai klish (default: bird.ctl); set wajib socket sudah ada + menjawab birdc

PARAM.name: path
PARAM.help: Socket UNIX absolute path; empty = show only
PARAM.help-id: Path socket UNIX absolut; kosong = tampilkan saja

COMMAND.name: birdc socket-del
COMMAND.help: Restore the birdc control socket to the default (bird.ctl)
COMMAND.help-id: Kembalikan socket kontrol birdc ke default (bird.ctl)
